flows.title: Invite a team member
steps: Go to the Team tab in the Dashboard and click Add member.
Add one or more email addresses, separated by a space or comma. People added together get the same roles and access.
Select which roles to assign. Review what each role can and cannot do first, and grant the lowest permission the person needs for their job.

Review the configuration and click Send invites, which emails each person the steps to accept. Invites expire after 10 days; a role can be edited later from the overflow menu beside the member, then Edit.

flows.title: Search the Dashboard
steps: Type a search term into the Dashboard's search: a name or email address, the last four digits of a card, an email receipt number, an invoice number, a date such as last week, or an object's ID.
The top results appear immediately. Click View all results or press Enter to see every match, then View all on a group for an expanded list with column headings, some of which sort.

To narrow a search, put a filter before the term, such as email:, name:, status: or created:, wrap a term containing a space in quotation marks, and put a hyphen before a filter to leave its matches out.
